Short answer first : No
Follow the rest of the thread only if you would like to know more and understand in detail.

nodes.author: vinodscaria
nodes.text:
Human Metapneumovirus (hMPV) is not a new virus.
It causes mild infections, usually similar to the common cold or flu
The virus belongs to Pneumoviridae family, which also has other well-known human viruses like mumps and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV)

nodes.author: TrumannNeumann
nodes.text: @vinodscaria With MMR being discontinued there seems to be an outbreak of mumps amongst young children in Keralam, prevalent in bigger towns like Trikakara

nodes.author: vinodscaria
nodes.text: The severity of the disease is similar to that of RSV. Severe disease is seen in children as well as elderly, apart from individuals with compromised immunity

nodes.author: vinodscaria
nodes.text:
hMPV shows a seasonal pattern, with the peak infections during winter.

In fact hMPV is quite prevalent with estimates of almost 1 in 10 of all lower respiratory tract infections in the US
https://t.co/ZQsh9L6L7Y

nodes.author: vinodscaria
nodes.text:
The virus was first isolated in Netherlands in 2001 children with respiratory tract infections. Serological studies by the authors suggested that by the age of 5 years, virtually all children in the Netherlands have been exposed to human metapneumovirus.
https://t.co/doRPgh7m7S

nodes.author: vinodscaria
nodes.text:
While in India, we seem to be eagerly keeping a close watch, my only point as a humble citizen is - how would we ?
Without approved diagnostics and a pathway for accelerated approvals for diagnostics, we are staring at a wall - black or white is for you to decide.

nodes.author: vinodscaria
nodes.text: @bani_jolly and I have written on the urgent need for rapid regulatory approvals for diagnostics in global / regional outbreak settings  https://t.co/wR540BmykC

nodes.author: vinodscaria
nodes.text:
@Mundra08 @bani_jolly hMPV and RSV are similar viruses and has been causing seasonal infections over many years now. In fact many of us would be seropositive .

As much as I know there is only a film array test (which essentially is a panel of pathogens) among approved diagnostics in India

nodes.author: vinodscaria
nodes.text: Preparedness starts with our ability to diagnose / detect the threat.
